<MethodEndpoint

</MethodEndpoint>



Admin only. Every backup in the backups volume — Famlin backup zips and,
until 1.0.0, legacy dumps — newest first, as `GET /api/auth/setup/backups`
lists them (plus `safety`), together with whether a backup is running,
the last restore's status, and `confirmName`: what to type to confirm a
restore (the family's brand name, or `Famlin`).
